name: container-management
title: Native container management with real Files picker and simulation
description: Native Container reads, dual-UI single-page configuration, real RouterOS directory CRUD and isolated lifecycle simulation.
creator: tom
notes: Continues on the same branch and Draft PR #30. The attached storage follow-up authorizes real directory mkdir/rename/recursive removal independently; Container lifecycle and image uploads remain simulation-only. Bound Files picker, inline edits, exact-path all-content deletion confirmation, fresh ID/type/reference guards, shared device locking and read-back recovery are implemented. Files use long **opaque IDs that may change on rename. The complete isolated test service passed real CRUD, request replay, cleanup, auth, defaults and exact embedded asset checks. Health inheritance hides custom details; resource limits default off and preserve edit values. 88 frontend tests and Go/race/build/vet/UI-isolation checks passed. Replay records are in memory; user visual/root review and future complete Container write/production acceptance remain pending.
